verdict.rationale: Mirrors previews corrections against stored traces before activation and compares outcomes against holdout groups. That is pre-activation review and online A/B comparison of context corrections, not evals run in a CI pipeline. Nothing in the pack shows CI integration, an eval runner, or gating deployments on results, and its own llms.txt positions evals as a separate category alongside tools like Braintrust and LangSmith.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
